b = int(input())
l = int(input()) - 1
r = int(input()) - 1

min_value = 26
for p_ord in range(ord('a'), ord('z') + 1):
    p = chr(p_ord)
    for q_ord in range(ord('a') + a, ord('z') + 1):
        q = chr(q_ord)
        rep = []

        # Append initial 'a' to 'z' characters
        for i in range(a):
            rep.append(chr(i + ord('a')))

        # Append 'p' b times
        rep.extend([p] * b)

        # Fill remaining characters to ensure each position has a unique character
        for i in range(a):
            f = [False] * 26
            for j in range(b + i, b + a + i):
                f[ord(rep[j]) - ord('a')] = True
            for j in range(26):
                if not f[j]:
                    rep.append(chr(j + ord('a')))
                    break

        # Append 'q' b times
        rep.extend([q] * b)

        flag = [False] * 26
        length_rep = len(rep)

        if r - l + 1 >= 100000:
            for ch in rep:
                flag[ord(ch) - ord('a')] = True
        else:
            for i in range(l, r + 1):
                flag[ord(rep[i % length_rep]) - ord('a')] = True

        ans = sum(flag)
        if ans < min_value:
            min_value = ans

print(min_value)
